ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85-90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) and 10-15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across 90% of the surface. High-intensity white mottling and contiguous patches are localized at the upper distal margins of both lobes. Discrete white punctate spots are distributed across the central dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary; right lobe trailing edge contains multiple deep notches and jagged peaks. Left lobe exhibits smaller, more uniform pixel-amplitude variations along its boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curve extending from the central notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast reddish-brown clusters (barnacle colonies) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple circular white scars are visible on the dark central pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions; a cluster of vertical parallel lines on the lower right lobe and several fine diagonal/horizontal scratches across the surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of reddish-brown barnacle clusters on the lateral tips; prominent white linear rake-like scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A clear, high-contrast white crescent-shaped marking is located in the middle-right quadrant of the fluke surface.
